description: Intent scope is written by hand, and in recent flows about half of the pull requests changed non-bookkeeping files that the intent did not list (package re-exports, READMEs, fixtures, a sibling test), while some listed files stayed unchanged. Each escape sends Stage 3 back to Stage 2 and costs about half an hour. There is no read-only way to check a draft intent before launching it.
goal: Add a read-only command 'holon intent-check <intent.json>' (a new self-registering command module, separate from the existing 'intent' command) that reads the intent's scope list and reports: (1) listed paths that do not exist in the target worktree and are not marked new by a naming convention, (2) companion files it proposes to add: tests that import a listed source module, source modules imported by a listed test, the package __init__.py that re-exports a listed module, and files that changed together with a listed file in the last 200 commits of git history (co-change count at or above 3), and (3) a listed file that none of the acceptance criteria text mentions by file or module name, as a warning only. Output is a plain text report plus a --json form; the exit code is 0 when there are no proposals and 1 when there are, and the command never modifies any file. Put the logic in one new module of at most 200 lines (import-graph and co-change helpers may sit in a second new module) and the command in a thin new command module.
rationale: Hand-guessed scope is the cheapest place to stop touch-set escapes: a companion file found before launch avoids a Stage 3 to Stage 2 round trip, and it also narrows overlap admission because the real touch set is known up front.
acceptance_criteria: 'holon intent-check <intent.json>' exists as a new command module under cli/commands, is discovered without editing any existing command module, and the existing 'intent' command is unchanged.

On a hermetic tmp_path git repository, a listed source module whose test file imports it yields that test file as a proposal, a listed test yields the source modules it imports, a listed module re-exported by its package __init__.py yields that __init__.py, and a pair that changed together in at least 3 commits yields the partner file; each case has a test.
A listed path that does not exist is reported, and a listed file that no acceptance criterion names is reported as a warning only; both have tests.
Exit code is 0 with no proposals and 1 with proposals; '--json' prints a machine-readable object with the keys missing, proposed and warnings; both are tested.
The command writes no file and runs no git command that mutates the repository; a test snapshots 'git status --porcelain' and the index before and after.
Every new module is at most 200 lines, holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged, and 'uv run pytest' on the new tests, 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
